text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, while I'm out on a walk...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Gahhh! Wait, come back! C'mon, lemme
pet your
gorgeous floof—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Aw maaan... It's gone. Ugh, I'm pooped
from all
of that running.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you there. Yeah, the person I'm
looking at
right now. I've got a question
for you.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yep! Got any fail-safe plans on how I
can manage
to pet that cat just now?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. Nothing beats lazing about in the
sun. So
you think I should just chill and
wait for it, huh?
choice_data_list_en: I'll chase after them with everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Weeelp, guess I'll just... yawn... have a little... nap...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Wake me up when the cat... comes... Zzzzz...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, I wait for the cat in Seiun Sky's
place
while she snoozes away.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's admirable how she's using everything
at her
disposal. Or so I think in an
attempt to console
myself after being so
easily manipulated...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Wow, nice idea! Well, get crackin', then.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Don't play dumb with me. You're
the one
who said chasing after the cat'll
work for sure, so
put your money where
your mouth is.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
As for me, I'm gonna wholeheartedly
cheer you on
from the sidelines!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh! It's right there in the shade of that
tree! You
can do it! Woo, go get 'em!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The cat proves to be far more wily than I

expected, and it seriously gives me the

runaround.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm unable to capture it on my own, so I
end up
asking <chrname> for
help...
